protocol.description: FailMem Single-Fault Channel Temporary Blockage Pilot Protocol (v2.0 - Natural Clearance & Strict Localization Hygiene)

obstacle_channel.geometry_rationale: Positioned directly between landmark cylinders (-1.1, -1.1) and (-1.1, 0.0), reducing corridor clearance below robot width (0.38m) to physically occlude south passage.

C1_continuous_blockage.name: Continuous Obstacle Blockage
C1_continuous_blockage.protocol_notes: Obstacle occludes corridor for entire duration. Nav2 attempts navigation and terminates or times out at 45.0s sim time without reaching goal.

C2_temporary_blockage_retry.name: Temporary Obstacle Blockage (Observe -> Remove -> Natural Raytrace -> Retry)
C2_temporary_blockage_retry.protocol_notes: Obstacle spawned before initial navigate. Upon initial failure/timeout, obstacle is deleted via /delete_entity and confirmed via Gazebo model states. Natural laser scan raytracing clears costmap without service purging. Observe action is executed, followed by retry with restored parameters.
